# Custom Empty/Error

Complex components default to shared LoadingState, EmptyState, and ErrorState with retry or a next action.

## Principle

The kit provides sensible defaults; capabilities own business availability; host configuration owns trimming and order; targeted extension points replace only what truly differs.

## Contract

Replace Empty/Loading/Error only for product copy, permission recovery, or a different business action; retain role, focus, and recovery semantics.

## Platforms

Vue, Flutter, Compose, and SwiftUI align semantically while retaining native syntax and interaction.

## Validation

Configuration tests cover defaults, removal, hiding, disabling, reordering, custom entries, and capability filtering.
